messages:
incident-bot: Pager: metering.embed_emitter.delay Spike in EU region · severity: P2 · runbook: metering/emit-delay 
Alex P: seeing a bunch of overage flags for embeddings billing in the dashboard, alerted by alerting rule `embeds.emit-delay > 5m`
Maya R: yep mirror here, some customers got immediate overage emails, others just delayed usage. I can join if needed.
Sam T: @Nate O are you oncall? can you take? looks like counts are delayed not doubled but flags are firing because quiet-window smearing.
Nate O: oncall here, taking. quick triage: emitter latency on eu-kafka-consumer up ~7m, downstream aggregator lagging. switching to live mode.
Alex P: confirmed consumer lag in prometheus: `consumer_lag{group="embed-emitter"} ~ 420000` (ms) and a backlog spike in s3-emiter-forwarder logs.
Maya R: mitigation idea: flip to fallback write path -> `emit-forwarder-fallback` to re-ingest backlog at lower priority. rolling patch suggestion in #eng-infra.
Nate O: doing the handoff now: enabling fallback path and rate-limiting replays to avoid double count. Running command: ``kubectl -n metering set env deploy/emit-forwarder FALLBACK=enabled``
Sam T: can you annotate customers impacted? we need to send a note if invoices might be off. quick list: custA-prod, custB-analytics, custC-dev (prelim).
Alex P: patch applied, consumers rebalanced. backlog ingestion rate at 120/s and error rate down. logs: `emit-replay processed 8,421 items`
incident-bot: Incident update: status=mitigating · owner=Nate O · runbook-step=enable-fallback · started=7751234569
Maya R: checking billing pipeline: aggregator shows delayed windowing from 12:03->12:10 UTC, tokens temporarily attributed to shadow bucket until reconciliation completes.
Nate O: key tradeoff: we re-ingested backlog with idempotency token, but quiet-window MR logic may have already emitted overage flags. working on suppressing alerts for 30m while we reconcile.
Sam T: action items: 1) suppress customer overage emails (ops task) 2) trigger reconciler job to de-dupe by idempotency key 3) notify CS for affected accounts.
Alex P: I pushed a quick reconciler job `reconcile-embeds --since 7751234400 --idempotency` to re-run aggregation in reconciliation mode. monitor with `reconciler_processed` metric.
Maya R: reconciler progress: 23% done, estimated 18m to finish. early checks: counts reduce for custA by ~11% after de-dupe pass.
Nate O: email draft for CS: "We experienced a short delay in embed usage reporting in EU, some customers received temporary overage flags; we are reconciling counts and suppressing emails; final billing will reflect corrected usage. ETA ~60m." approve?
Sam T: approve from me. add a line about no charge increases expected after reconciliation.
Alex P: reconciler finished at 7751234590. final: most counts corrected, two small customers still in delayed bucket — post-processing scheduled.
incident-bot: Incident resolved: status=resolved · closed_by=Nate O · closed_ts=7751234590 · summary=EMBED emitter lag caused transient overage flags; fallback and reconciler applied; customer emails suppressed and CS notified.
Maya R: postmortem note: root cause likely a GC pause on emitter pod + slow consumer restart; recommend adding consumer replicas and improving backpressure metrics; will file PM with eng-infra.
Nate O: thanks team. follow-up: run a dry-run of reconciler weekly to catch future quiet-window edgecases. :thumbsup:
